parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    i.request,
    p.id,
    p.intent_json,
    p.forbid_json,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.l1a_unit AS l
      WHERE l.book_id = p.id
        AND l.is_locked
        AND l.is_valid
        AND NOT l.is_shadow
    ) AS world_write_allowed
  FROM input AS i
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS p
    ON p.id = (i.request->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND p.local_operator_id = (i.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
), resolved AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'node_code', b.node_code,
        'model_config_id', b.model_config_id,
        'model_config_version', b.model_config_version,
        'prompt_config_id', b.prompt_config_id,
        'prompt_version', b.prompt_version,
        'template_type', b.template_type,
        'temperature', b.temperature,
        'prompt_text', b.prompt_text,
        'prompt_status', b.prompt_status,
        'model_name', b.model_name,
        'provider_base_url', b.provider_base_url,
        'api_key_ref', b.api_key_ref,
        'routing_config_jsonb', b.routing_config_jsonb,
        'parameters_jsonb', b.parameters_jsonb
      )
      FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
      WHERE b.local_operator_id = (s.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
        AND b.node_code = 'FP002-04'
        AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS model_config
  FROM scoped AS s
)
SELECT
  r.request,
  r.id IS NOT NULL AS book_exists,
  r.world_write_allowed,
  r.model_config IS NOT NULL AS model_config_ready,
  r.model_config,
  jsonb_build_object('intent', r.intent_json, 'forbid', r.forbid_json) AS book_context,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'board_type', ws.board_type,
      'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
      'atom_key', ws.atom_key,
      'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
      'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims
    ) ORDER BY ws.created_at)
    FROM public.world_state AS ws
    WHERE ws.book_id = r.id
      AND ws.is_active
      AND ws.is_formal
      AND ws.is_valid
      AND NOT ws.is_shadow
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS existing_world
FROM resolved AS r;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    i.request,
    p.id AS book_id,
    p.title,
    p.genre_main,
    p.stage_code,
    p.intent_json,
    p.id IS NOT NULL AND public.v7_design_editable(p.id) AS world_write_allowed
  FROM input AS i
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS p
    ON p.id = (i.request->>'book_id')::uuid
   AND p.local_operator_id = (i.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
), requested_atoms AS (
  SELECT s.*, atom.value AS atom
  FROM scoped AS s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN s.request->>'action' = 'save_candidate' THEN s.request->'atoms' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS atom(value)
  WHERE s.book_id IS NOT NULL AND s.world_write_allowed
), updated_atoms AS (
  UPDATE api.v_world_candidate_write AS current
  SET board_type = requested.atom->>'board_type',
      atom_type = requested.atom->>'atom_type',
      atom_key = requested.atom->>'atom_key',
      atom_value_jsonb = requested.atom->'atom_value_jsonb',
      affordance_dims = requested.atom->'affordance_dims',
      source_type = requested.atom->>'source_type',
      setting_layer = requested.atom->>'setting_layer'
  FROM requested_atoms AS requested
  WHERE current.book_id = requested.book_id
    AND current.local_operator_id = (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    AND (
      current.id::text = requested.atom->>'client_ref'
      OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM api.v_world_candidate_write AS identified
          WHERE identified.book_id = requested.book_id
            AND identified.id::text = requested.atom->>'client_ref'
        )
        AND current.setting_layer = requested.atom->>'setting_layer'
        AND current.atom_key = requested.atom->>'atom_key'
      )
    )
  RETURNING current.id, current.atom_key, current.setting_layer
), inserted_atoms AS (
  INSERT INTO api.v_world_candidate_write(
    book_id, local_operator_id, revision_no, supersedes_id, board_type, atom_type,
    atom_key, atom_value_jsonb, affordance_dims, source_type, setting_layer
  )
  SELECT
    requested.book_id,
    (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid,
    1,
    (
      SELECT formal.id
      FROM public.world_state AS formal
      WHERE formal.book_id = requested.book_id
        AND formal.is_formal AND formal.is_valid AND NOT formal.is_shadow
        AND (
          formal.id::text = requested.atom->>'formal_id'
          OR (
            requested.atom->>'formal_id' IS NULL
            AND formal.setting_layer = requested.atom->>'setting_layer'
            AND formal.atom_key = requested.atom->>'atom_key'
          )
        )
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN formal.id::text = requested.atom->>'formal_id' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, formal.revision_no DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    requested.atom->>'board_type', requested.atom->>'atom_type', requested.atom->>'atom_key',
    requested.atom->'atom_value_jsonb', requested.atom->'affordance_dims',
    requested.atom->>'source_type', requested.atom->>'setting_layer'
  FROM requested_atoms AS requested
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM api.v_world_candidate_write AS current
    WHERE current.book_id = requested.book_id
      AND current.local_operator_id = (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
      AND (
        current.id::text = requested.atom->>'client_ref'
        OR (current.setting_layer = requested.atom->>'setting_layer' AND current.atom_key = requested.atom->>'atom_key')
      )
  )
  RETURNING id, atom_key, setting_layer
), deleted_candidate_atoms AS (
  DELETE FROM api.v_world_candidate_write AS current
  USING scoped AS s
  WHERE s.request->>'action' = 'save_candidate'
    AND s.book_id IS NOT NULL AND s.world_write_allowed
    AND current.book_id = s.book_id
    AND current.local_operator_id = (s.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.request->'atoms') AS requested(atom)
      WHERE current.id::text = requested.atom->>'client_ref'
         OR (current.setting_layer = requested.atom->>'setting_layer' AND current.atom_key = requested.atom->>'atom_key')
    )
  RETURNING current.id
), requested_bindings AS (
  SELECT s.*, binding.value AS binding
  FROM scoped AS s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN s.request->>'action' = 'save_candidate' THEN s.request->'bindings' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS binding(value)
  WHERE s.book_id IS NOT NULL AND s.world_write_allowed
), updated_bindings AS (
  UPDATE api.v_world_binding_candidate_write AS current
  SET from_ref_type = 'world', from_ref_id = requested.binding->>'from_ref',
      to_ref_type = 'world', to_ref_id = requested.binding->>'to_ref',
      binding_type = requested.binding->>'binding_type',
      binding_strength = requested.binding->>'binding_strength',
      setting_layer = requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
  FROM requested_bindings AS requested
  WHERE current.book_id = requested.book_id
    AND current.local_operator_id = (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    AND (
      current.id::text = requested.binding->>'client_ref'
      OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM api.v_world_binding_candidate_write AS identified
          WHERE identified.book_id = requested.book_id
            AND identified.id::text = requested.binding->>'client_ref'
        )
        AND current.from_ref_type = 'world' AND current.from_ref_id = requested.binding->>'from_ref'
        AND current.to_ref_type = 'world' AND current.to_ref_id = requested.binding->>'to_ref'
        AND current.binding_type = requested.binding->>'binding_type'
        AND current.setting_layer = requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
      )
    )
  RETURNING current.id, current.from_ref_id, current.to_ref_id, current.binding_type, current.setting_layer
), inserted_bindings AS (
  INSERT INTO api.v_world_binding_candidate_write(
    book_id, local_operator_id, revision_no, supersedes_id, from_ref_type, from_ref_id,
    to_ref_type, to_ref_id, binding_type, binding_strength, setting_layer
  )
  SELECT
    requested.book_id,
    (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid,
    1,
    (
      SELECT formal.id
      FROM public.world_binding AS formal
      WHERE formal.book_id = requested.book_id
        AND formal.is_formal AND formal.is_valid AND NOT formal.is_shadow
        AND (
          formal.id::text = requested.binding->>'formal_id'
          OR (
            requested.binding->>'formal_id' IS NULL
            AND formal.from_ref_type = 'world' AND formal.from_ref_id = requested.binding->>'from_ref'
            AND formal.to_ref_type = 'world' AND formal.to_ref_id = requested.binding->>'to_ref'
            AND formal.binding_type = requested.binding->>'binding_type'
            AND formal.setting_layer = requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
          )
        )
      ORDER BY CASE WHEN formal.id::text = requested.binding->>'formal_id' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, formal.revision_no DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    'world', requested.binding->>'from_ref', 'world', requested.binding->>'to_ref',
    requested.binding->>'binding_type', requested.binding->>'binding_strength', requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
  FROM requested_bindings AS requested
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM api.v_world_binding_candidate_write AS current
    WHERE current.book_id = requested.book_id
      AND current.local_operator_id = (requested.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
      AND (
        current.id::text = requested.binding->>'client_ref'
        OR (
          current.from_ref_type = 'world' AND current.from_ref_id = requested.binding->>'from_ref'
          AND current.to_ref_type = 'world' AND current.to_ref_id = requested.binding->>'to_ref'
          AND current.binding_type = requested.binding->>'binding_type'
          AND current.setting_layer = requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
        )
      )
  )
  RETURNING id, from_ref_id, to_ref_id, binding_type, setting_layer
), deleted_candidate_bindings AS (
  DELETE FROM api.v_world_binding_candidate_write AS current
  USING scoped AS s
  WHERE s.request->>'action' = 'save_candidate'
    AND s.book_id IS NOT NULL AND s.world_write_allowed
    AND current.book_id = s.book_id
    AND current.local_operator_id = (s.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.request->'bindings') AS requested(binding)
      WHERE current.id::text = requested.binding->>'client_ref'
         OR (
           current.from_ref_type = 'world' AND current.from_ref_id = requested.binding->>'from_ref'
           AND current.to_ref_type = 'world' AND current.to_ref_id = requested.binding->>'to_ref'
           AND current.binding_type = requested.binding->>'binding_type'
           AND current.setting_layer = requested.binding->>'setting_layer'
         )
    )
  RETURNING current.id
), formal_projection AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', ws.id, 'formal_id', ws.id, 'board_type', ws.board_type, 'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
        'atom_key', ws.atom_key, 'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
        'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims, 'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer,
        'is_formal', ws.is_formal
      ) ORDER BY ws.setting_layer, ws.board_type, ws.atom_key)
      FROM public.world_state AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = s.book_id AND ws.is_formal AND ws.is_valid AND NOT ws.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS formal_atoms,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', wb.id, 'formal_id', wb.id, 'from_ref_id', wb.from_ref_id, 'to_ref_id', wb.to_ref_id,
        'binding_type', wb.binding_type, 'binding_strength', wb.binding_strength,
        'setting_layer', wb.setting_layer, 'is_formal', wb.is_formal
      ) ORDER BY wb.created_at, wb.id)
      FROM public.world_binding AS wb
      WHERE wb.book_id = s.book_id AND wb.is_formal AND wb.is_valid AND NOT wb.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS formal_bindings,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT max(ws.revision_no) FROM public.world_state AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = s.book_id AND ws.is_formal AND ws.is_valid AND NOT ws.is_shadow
    ), 1) AS formal_revision,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'l1a_id', lu.id, 'l1a_name', lu.l1a_name, 'world_progression', lu.world_progress_json
      ) ORDER BY lu.l1a_index)
      FROM public.l1a_unit AS lu
      WHERE lu.book_id = s.book_id AND lu.is_formal AND lu.is_valid
        AND NOT lu.is_shadow AND lu.world_progress_json IS NOT NULL
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS world_progressions
  FROM scoped AS s
), candidate_projection_base AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', ws.id, 'formal_id', ws.supersedes_id, 'board_type', ws.board_type, 'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
        'atom_key', ws.atom_key, 'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
        'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims, 'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer,
        'is_formal', false
      ) ORDER BY ws.setting_layer, ws.board_type, ws.atom_key)
      FROM public.world_state AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT ws.is_formal AND ws.is_valid AND NOT ws.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidate_atoms,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', wb.id, 'formal_id', wb.supersedes_id, 'from_ref_id', wb.from_ref_id, 'to_ref_id', wb.to_ref_id,
        'binding_type', wb.binding_type, 'binding_strength', wb.binding_strength,
        'setting_layer', wb.setting_layer, 'is_formal', false
      ) ORDER BY wb.created_at, wb.id)
      FROM public.world_binding AS wb
      WHERE wb.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT wb.is_formal AND wb.is_valid AND NOT wb.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidate_bindings,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(ws.id ORDER BY ws.id)
      FROM public.world_state AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT ws.is_formal AND ws.is_valid AND NOT ws.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS world_candidate_ids,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(wb.id ORDER BY wb.id)
      FROM public.world_binding AS wb
      WHERE wb.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT wb.is_formal AND wb.is_valid AND NOT wb.is_shadow
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS binding_candidate_ids,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(formal.id ORDER BY formal.id)
      FROM public.world_state AS formal
      WHERE formal.book_id = f.book_id AND formal.is_formal AND formal.is_valid AND NOT formal.is_shadow
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.world_state AS candidate
          WHERE candidate.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT candidate.is_formal
            AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow
            AND candidate.setting_layer = formal.setting_layer AND candidate.atom_key = formal.atom_key
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS delete_world_ids,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT max(ws.revision_no)
      FROM public.world_state AS ws
      WHERE ws.book_id = f.book_id AND NOT ws.is_formal AND ws.is_valid AND NOT ws.is_shadow
    ), 1) AS candidate_revision
  FROM formal_projection AS f
), candidate_projection AS (
  SELECT
    base.*,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(formal.id ORDER BY formal.id)
      FROM public.world_binding AS formal
      WHERE formal.book_id = base.book_id AND formal.is_formal AND formal.is_valid AND NOT formal.is_shadow
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.world_binding AS candidate
          WHERE candidate.book_id = base.book_id AND NOT candidate.is_formal
            AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow
            AND candidate.from_ref_type = formal.from_ref_type AND candidate.from_ref_id = formal.from_ref_id
            AND candidate.to_ref_type = formal.to_ref_type AND candidate.to_ref_id = formal.to_ref_id
            AND candidate.binding_type = formal.binding_type AND candidate.setting_layer = formal.setting_layer
            AND COALESCE(candidate.origin_l1a_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
              = COALESCE(formal.origin_l1a_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.world_state AS deleted
          WHERE deleted.id::text IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(base.delete_world_ids))
            AND ((formal.from_ref_type = 'world' AND formal.from_ref_id = deleted.atom_key)
              OR (formal.to_ref_type = 'world' AND formal.to_ref_id = deleted.atom_key))
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS delete_world_binding_ids
  FROM candidate_projection_base AS base
), confirmed AS (
  SELECT public.rpc_commit_world_settings(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', s.request->>'local_operator_id',
    'book_id', s.request->>'book_id',
    'idempotency_key', s.request->>'idempotency_key',
    'world_candidate_ids', s.request->'world_candidate_ids',
    'binding_candidate_ids', s.request->'binding_candidate_ids',
    'delete_world_ids', s.request->'delete_world_ids',
    'delete_world_binding_ids', s.request->'delete_world_binding_ids'
  ))) AS value
  FROM scoped AS s
  WHERE s.request->>'action' = 'confirm' AND s.book_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN projection.book_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', false,
    'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
    'redacted_error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED', 'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.')
  )
  WHEN projection.request->>'action' = 'read_versions' THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
    'result', jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'read_versions',
      'frozen', NOT projection.world_write_allowed,
      'world_progressions', projection.world_progressions,
      'book', jsonb_build_object(
        'title', projection.title,
        'genre_main', projection.genre_main,
        'stage_code', projection.stage_code,
        'intent_json', COALESCE(projection.intent_json, '{}'::jsonb)
      ),
      'versions',
        CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(projection.formal_atoms) > 0 THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'snapshot_key', 'formal:current',
          'revision', projection.formal_revision,
          'state', 'formal',
          'atoms', projection.formal_atoms,
          'bindings', projection.formal_bindings
        )) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        || CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(projection.world_candidate_ids) > 0 THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'snapshot_key', 'candidate:current',
          'revision', projection.candidate_revision,
          'state', 'candidate',
          'atoms', projection.candidate_atoms,
          'bindings', projection.candidate_bindings,
          'world_candidate_ids', projection.world_candidate_ids,
          'binding_candidate_ids', projection.binding_candidate_ids,
          'delete_world_ids', projection.delete_world_ids,
          'delete_world_binding_ids', projection.delete_world_binding_ids
        )) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        || COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'snapshot_key', 'history:' || history.snapshot_no,
            'revision', history.snapshot_no,
            'state', 'history',
            'atoms', COALESCE((
              SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', ws.id, 'formal_id', ws.id, 'board_type', ws.board_type, 'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
                'atom_key', ws.atom_key, 'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
                'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims, 'setting_layer', ws.setting_layer,
                'is_formal', false
              ) ORDER BY ws.setting_layer, ws.board_type, ws.atom_key)
              FROM public.world_state AS ws
              WHERE ws.id = ANY(ARRAY(
                SELECT value::uuid
                FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(history.result #> '{ids,world_ids}') AS item(value)
              ))
            ), '[]'::jsonb),
            'bindings', COALESCE((
              SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', wb.id, 'formal_id', wb.id, 'from_ref_id', wb.from_ref_id, 'to_ref_id', wb.to_ref_id,
                'binding_type', wb.binding_type, 'binding_strength', wb.binding_strength,
                'setting_layer', wb.setting_layer, 'is_formal', false
              ) ORDER BY wb.created_at, wb.id)
              FROM public.world_binding AS wb
              WHERE wb.id = ANY(ARRAY(
                SELECT value::uuid
                FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(history.result #> '{ids,world_binding_ids}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS item(value)
              ))
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
          ) ORDER BY history.snapshot_no DESC)
          FROM (
            SELECT
              request_log.result,
              row_number() OVER (ORDER BY request_log.created_at, request_log.operation, request_log.idempotency_key) AS snapshot_no,
              count(*) OVER () AS snapshot_count
            FROM public.product_request_log AS request_log
            WHERE request_log.book_id = projection.book_id
              AND request_log.operation IN ('rpc_create_book_project', 'rpc_commit_world_settings')
              AND jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(request_log.result #> '{ids,world_ids}', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
          ) AS history
          WHERE history.snapshot_no < history.snapshot_count
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'current_snapshot_key', CASE
        WHEN jsonb_array_length(projection.world_candidate_ids) > 0 THEN 'candidate:current'
        WHEN jsonb_array_length(projection.formal_atoms) > 0 THEN 'formal:current'
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
  )
  WHEN NOT projection.world_write_allowed THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', false,
    'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
    'redacted_error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'DESIGN_LOCKED', 'message', 'World settings are read-only after L1A sorting is confirmed.')
  )
  WHEN projection.request->>'action' = 'save_candidate' THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
    'result', jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'candidate_saved',
      'snapshot_key', 'candidate:current',
      'world_candidate_ids', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(written.id ORDER BY written.id)
        FROM (SELECT id FROM updated_atoms UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_atoms) AS written
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'binding_candidate_ids', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(written.id ORDER BY written.id)
        FROM (SELECT id FROM updated_bindings UNION ALL SELECT id FROM inserted_bindings) AS written
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    )
  )
  WHEN projection.request->>'action' = 'confirm' THEN (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN response.value->>'ok' = 'true' THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', true,
        'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
        'result', response.value - 'ok'
      )
      ELSE response.value || jsonb_build_object('correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id')
    END
    FROM confirmed AS response
  )
  ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', false,
    'correlation_id', projection.request->>'correlation_id',
    'redacted_error', jsonb_build_object('code', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'message', 'The request could not be accepted.')
  )
END AS response
FROM candidate_projection AS projection;
